settings.title: Creator Profile
settings.subtitle: Fill this in so PublishKit's AI generates titles, descriptions, thumbnails, scripts, and social posts that sound like {name}, not generic AI. Fields marked * are required. The rest are optional but each one sharpens your results.
settings.subtitleNoName: Fill this in so PublishKit's AI generates titles, descriptions, thumbnails, scripts, and social posts that sound like you, not generic AI. Fields marked * are required. The rest are optional but each one sharpens your results.
settings.brandColorError1: Brand Color 1 is not a valid color name or hex code.
settings.brandColorError2: Brand Color 2 is not a valid color name or hex code.
settings.meaningfulError: Please write this properly so we can generate good scripts for you.
settings.section1.title: The basics
settings.section1.subtitle: Required. Without these the AI can't even start.
settings.name.label: Your name / channel name
settings.handle.label: YouTube handle
settings.niche.label: Your niche / topic — be specific
settings.niche.placeholder: e.g. AI tools for content creators (NOT just 'tech')
settings.positioning.label: One-line positioning
settings.positioning.hint: Who you are in 10 words. Example: "18 y/o building a 6-figure AI agency" or "Ex-doctor teaching evidence-based fitness".
settings.positioning.placeholder: One short sentence that sums you up
settings.language.label: Default output language
settings.language.hint: Used for titles, descriptions, timestamps, scripts, and MultiPost.
settings.tone.label: Default tone
settings.tone.hint: How you talk in your videos. You can override this per-script in Script Writer.
settings.section2.title: Your audience
settings.section2.subtitle: Telling the AI who you're talking TO is half the battle.
settings.targetAudience.label: Who exactly watches your content
settings.targetAudience.hint: Age, profession, goals. Example: "20-25 year old Indian college students learning AI/coding"
settings.targetAudience.placeholder: Be specific — age, what they do, what they want
settings.audiencePainPoint.label: Their biggest pain point you solve
settings.audiencePainPoint.hint: The single problem they wake up thinking about, that you address.
settings.audiencePainPoint.placeholder: e.g. "They feel left behind by AI but every tutorial is for engineers"
settings.audienceLevel.label: Their skill level in your niche
settings.audienceTransformation.label: What they want to become after watching
settings.audienceTransformation.hint: The transformation. Example: 'A confident creator who ships content weekly without burnout.'
settings.audienceTransformation.placehol: The version of themselves they aspire to
settings.section3.title: Visual identity
settings.section3.subtitle: Required so thumbnail prompts feature YOU and your brand colors, not stock imagery.
settings.appearance.label: Your on-camera appearance
settings.appearance.hint: Face, hair, what you usually wear. Helps thumbnails actually look like you.
settings.appearance.placeholder: e.g. Indian male in his 20s, short hair, usually wearing a black hoodie or casual t-shirt
settings.brandColors.hint: Brand colors — type a name like {color1} or a hex code like {hex1}, or click the swatch.
settings.section4.title: Voice & tone — sharper scripts
settings.section4.subtitle: Optional, but every field here makes your scripts sound less generic.
settings.catchphrases.label: Catchphrases you use often
settings.catchphrases.hint: Words/phrases your audience associates with you. Example: "Let me explain", "Big idea is this", "Pause the video right here".
settings.avoidWords.label: Words / topics you NEVER use
settings.avoidWords.hint: Stuff that breaks your brand. Example: "Avoid corporate jargon, no swearing, never the word synergy"
settings.hookStyle.label: How you usually START videos (hook style)
settings.hookStyle.hint: Examples: "I always open with a question", "Cold-open with the most shocking part", "Stat first, name second"
settings.ctaStyle.label: How you usually END videos (CTA style)
settings.ctaStyle.hint: Examples: "Follow for more AI tools", "Save this for later", "Comment your biggest takeaway"
settings.contentPillars.label: Your content pillars (3-5 topics)
settings.contentPillars.hint: The main themes you post about. Helps AI stay on-brand across scripts.
settings.contentPillars.placeholder: e.g. "AI tools, freelancing income, creator burnout, productivity"
settings.preferredVideoLength.label: Preferred video length
settings.preferredVideoLength.hint: What duration works best for your audience? Script Writer will optimize pacing for this.
settings.section5.title: Advanced — fine-tune your voice
settings.section5.subtitle: Power-user fields. Only fill what's relevant to you.
settings.age.label: Your age (optional)
settings.whatMakesDifferent.label: What makes you different from others in your niche
settings.whatMakesDifferent.hint: Why someone should follow YOU vs the 100 others doing the same thing.
settings.personalStory.label: Your personal story (background, journey)
settings.personalStory.hint: Journey, struggles, wins. This is what creates relatability in scripts.
settings.credentials.label: Credentials / proof you can mention
settings.credentials.hint: Followers, revenue, results, experience. Use only if it's genuinely yours.
settings.addressForm.label: Hindi/Hinglish address-form (तुम / आप)
settings.addressForm.hint: How you address your audience in Hindi videos. "Skip" if you only output English.
settings.usesSlang.label: I use slang
settings.usesMemes.label: I reference memes
settings.usesCursing.label: I curse / swear
settings.bestVideoHooks.label: Your 3 best-performing video hooks (copy-paste the openings)
settings.bestVideoHooks.hint: If you have past hits, paste the first 2-3 lines here. AI will study what worked.
settings.bestVideoHooks.placeholder:
1. "I tried 5 AI tools so you don't have to..."
2. "Stop scrolling — this Notion template just saved me ₹20,000..."
3. ...
settings.hookFormulas.label: Hook formulas that work for you
settings.hookFormulas.hint: Examples: "money saved", "before vs after", "the one thing nobody tells you about X", "I was wrong about Y".
